NAM.note: A payment network for grants; no public register keyed on the national ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Namibia's instant payment network, operated by Instant Payments Namibia (a Bank of Namibia subsidiary), processed its first live government grant payments, with Bank Windhoek disbursing a batch to Marginalised Beneficiaries on 17 June 2026 and Letshego Bank Namibia certified to receive grant payments.
